checks.why: a fixture in conftest.py is injected by PARAMETER NAME into the tests of its directory subtree, and is in no test's file
an autouse fixture runs before every test in its scope, named by nothing at all
a module-level function named like a test in a module pytest does not collect (tests/helpers.py) is the route to the change, not a test: the test that calls it is selected, the helper is not
avoid: treat them as tests to run

checks.why: CONTROL: a module-level test_ function in a collected test module is still a test
